method: Static inspection of drivemate-app search code on its branch head, read-only. No device, no emulator, no network calls made.

search_sources.LOCAL: OfflineSearch over the on-phone UK search list (postcodes, streets, places from Ordnance Survey Open Names, OSM addresses, and the national postcode file). Asked when the query is 3+ characters or contains a full postcode.
search_sources.OWN: OwnPlaces.search (DriveMate business list). Asked only when a current position is known.
search_sources.online_providers: None called. Geocoder.kt states that typed text and position are never sent. Photon, Nominatim, postcodes.io and TomTom are not referenced by the search path (the TomTom flag is unused).

response_availability.uk_postcode: offline list: postcode centre only (kind POSTCODE, labelled as area centre)
response_availability.house_number_with_street: offline list from OSM addresses; labelled Address; missing numbers reported as not found
response_availability.house_number_with_postcode_no_street: map branch 0fd00a5 writes these; app behaviour not yet verified on a device
response_availability.business_or_place: offline list (OS Open Names places, OSM POIs) and OwnPlaces
response_availability.online_case: no online search source exists in the current search path
response_availability.offline_case: the whole search path is offline by design; no separate offline-only result set

not_verified: Actual result lists on a device or emulator (needs drivemate-tests emulator run)
Response timing under the per-source timeout
status: Complete for static reproduction at the commits named; the device-level part is still open
